0022600223.text: The Pelicans (4-7, 11th in the West, 3-3 at home) are on a three-game losing streak and host the Brooklyn Nets (2-8, 13th in the East, 1-3 at home), who have lost two straight. New Orleans is without Trendon Watford (ankle) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), both listed as out, while Trey Murphy III is day-to-day with knee tendinitis and a game-time decision. Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise), who is out, and Nolan Traore is day-to-day with calf soreness and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and they split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the Pelicans winning the last meeting 116-113 in New Orleans on January 14, 2026.
